title: Section 590.1 – Add new Informational Notes Nos. 1 and 2 at the end of Section 590.1 to read as follows:
officialText:
Informational Note No. 1: See Chapter 1 of Title 28 of the Administrative Code for retroactive requirements of
Section 28-315.8.2 as it pertains to “Connections for Temporary External Generators.”
Informational Note No. 2: See Section G304.5 of Appendix G of the New York City Building Code for additional
construction standards with respect to temporary external generator connections in areas of special flood hazard.
